judgment.en_legge: Lu intimates that (in the condition which it denotes) there may be some little attainment and progress. If the stranger or traveller be firm and correct as he ought to be, there will be good fortune.

tuan.zh_hant: 旅小亨，柔得中乎外而順乎剛，止而麗乎明，是以小亨旅貞吉也。旅之時義大矣哉！
tuan.zh_hans: 旅小亨，柔得中乎外而顺乎刚，止而丽乎明，是以小亨旅贞吉也。旅之时义大矣哉！

image.zh_hant: 山上有火，旅。君子以明慎用刑而不留獄。
image.zh_hans: 山上有火，旅。君子以明慎用刑而不留狱。

text.en_legge: The first line, divided, shows the stranger mean and meanly occupied. It is thus that he brings on himself (further) calamity.

text.zh_hant: 旅即次，懷其資，得童僕貞。
text.zh_hans: 旅即次，怀其资，得童仆贞。
text.en_legge: The second line, divided, shows the stranger, occupying his lodging-house, carrying with him his means of livelihood, and provided with good and trusty servants.

text.zh_hant: 旅焚其次，喪其童僕貞，厲。
text.zh_hans: 旅焚其次，丧其童仆贞，厉。
text.en_legge: The third line, undivided, shows the stranger, burning his lodging-house, and having lost his servants. However firm and correct he (try to) be, he will be in peril.

xiao_xiang.zh_hant: 旅焚其次，亦以傷矣。以旅與下，其義喪也。
xiao_xiang.zh_hans: 旅焚其次，亦以伤矣。以旅与下，其义丧也。

text.zh_hant: 旅于處，得其資斧，我心不快。
text.zh_hans: 旅于处，得其资斧，我心不快。
text.en_legge: The fourth line, undivided, shows the traveller in a resting-place, having (also) the means of livelihood and the axe, (but still saying), 'I am not at ease in my mind.'

xiao_xiang.zh_hant: 旅于處、未得位也。得其資斧、心未快也。
xiao_xiang.zh_hans: 旅于处、未得位也。得其资斧、心未快也。

text.en_legge: The fifth line, divided, shows its subject shooting a pheasant. He will lose his arrow, but in the end he will obtain praise and a (high) charge.

text.zh_hant: 鳥焚其巢，旅人先笑後號咷。喪牛于易，凶。
text.zh_hans: 鸟焚其巢，旅人先笑后号咷。丧牛于易，凶。
text.en_legge: The sixth line, undivided, suggests the idea of a bird burning its nest. The stranger, (thus represented), first laughs and then cries out. He has lost his ox(-like docility) too readily and easily. There will be evil.

xiao_xiang.zh_hant: 以旅在上、其義焚也，喪牛于易、終莫之聞也。
xiao_xiang.zh_hans: 以旅在上、其义焚也，丧牛于易、终莫之闻也。
